entries.zh: 天理；良心（人本有的道德准则与是非之心）
entries.en: conscience; the natural moral law (heavenly principle)

entries.zh: 公道；良心（居心公正、待人处事公平）
entries.en: conscience; equity, fairness

entries.zh: 胜（在争讼、辩论中取胜）；把争端辩到上风
entries.en: to win, to prevail (in a dispute); to bring an argument to a winning close
entries.notes: R 栏原缺，M 栏「Tēng. gua fēng lī」疑为成句（我…你）未详；H「胜」与 L「concluir en disputa」义相合。

entries.zh: 近；靠近〔与西语「concluir algo（了结某事）」不合，疑栏位错置〕
entries.en: near, close (does not match "to conclude sth."; the columns appear misaligned)
entries.notes: M、R 两栏均 T99 污损；H「近」与 L 义不相涉，疑原稿栏位错置或字头误植。

entries.zh: 完；完成、了结、做到底
entries.en: to finish, to complete, to bring to an end

entries.zh: 易（容易；变易）〔与西语「concluir（了结）」不合，疑栏位错置〕
entries.en: easy; to change (does not match "to conclude"; columns appear misaligned)
entries.notes: M「xn y」、R「xȳ」仅存「易」音；H 与 L 义不相涉，且 M 首音节残缺，暂存疑。

entries.zh: 几（多少；几微）〔与西语「concluir」不合，疑栏位错置〕
entries.en: how many; the incipient (does not match "to conclude")
entries.notes: M「gug」、R「guìi」音写难与「几」密合，H 与 L 义亦不合，暂存疑。

entries.zh: 明；明白、了结清楚（指已完成之物，如屋已落成）
entries.en: clear, settled (of a completed thing, e.g. a finished house)
entries.notes: L「concluida cosa, id est, sea casa」以房屋为例，H「明」取「明白、了结」义，属由四栏推得。

entries.zh: 明事；事已议定、明白无疑
entries.en: a settled matter; business brought to a clear conclusion

entries.zh: 界限；止境、定限（事到尽头、有了分界）
entries.en: boundary, limit; the end or term of a matter
entries.notes: M 栏夹写西语「acabado lābro」疑为行间批注；H、R 并作「界限」，L 取「有止境」义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [damaged in the original; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H、R 两栏原缺，M 仅存「tiēn păg.」残迹，疑与第 3 条重出。

entries.zh: 雷同；彼此相同、随声附合
entries.en: to be identical, to coincide; to echo one another

entries.zh: 和；和睦、心志相合（天然的与道义上的同心）
entries.en: harmony, concord; to be of one will (natural and moral concord)

entries.zh: 心平；心意相合、心气平和〔H 栏作「心评」，疑为同音借字〕
entries.en: hearts at peace with one another; mutual agreement of wills
entries.notes: 「评」与「平」同音（pêng），依 L「心志相合」及 M/R 音写，疑原字为「平」。

entries.zh: 和同；同心相合、彼此一致
entries.en: concord, mutual agreement; to be of one mind

entries.zh: 和合；融洽投合、合为一体
entries.en: harmonious union; to agree well together, to suit one another

entries.zh: 鞋袜相捷；如鞋袜之贴脚相合（喻彼此契合、投合）
entries.en: to fit each other like shoe and sock; to conform, to suit one another
entries.notes: H 末字原件磨损，封存作「捷」（另疑「搓」）；依 L「conformarse」取「贴合」义。

entries.zh: 和顺；彼此和睦顺从
entries.en: harmonious and compliant; on amicable terms with one another

entries.zh: 蚌；大贝、大蛤
entries.en: large bivalve; mussel, large clam
entries.notes: R 栏「tâng」与「蚌」音不合，疑与次条窜行；H、M 与 L「conchas grandes」三相合。

entries.zh: 蚝；牡蛎（中国所产贝类）
entries.en: oyster; Chinese oyster shells
entries.notes: R 栏「kôn」与「蚝」音不合，疑与前条窜行；H「蚝」与 M「ō」相合，L 作 conchas chinas。
